senses.gloss: (cmp. אור, נהר) to be shining, showy, proud, v. יָהִיר.
(denom. of יָהִיר) to assume airs, to be boastful.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 66b:6">Pes. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המִתְיָהֵר וכ׳</he> whoever is boastful, if he is wise, his wisdom will desert him &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:10">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>שׁאין עושין אלא להִתְיָהֵר בו</he> they do good only to boast themselves thereof; <he>וכל המתיהר וכ׳</he> and whoever boasts, falls a prey to Gehenna.
